blocks.text: Item 1. Business
Acme Widgets designs and manufactures industrial fasteners and precision widgets for automotive and aerospace customers. Our largest customer accounted for 14% of net sales in fiscal 2023.
Consolidated Statements of Operations

| (Millions) | 2023 | 2022 |
|---|---|---|
| Net sales | 4,210 | 3,880 |
| Cost of sales | 2,945 | 2,790 |
| Gross profit | 1,265 | 1,090 |
| Operating income | 612 | 498 |
| Net income | 455 | 371 |

|---|---|---|
| Net cash provided by operating activities | 702 | 615 |
| Purchases of property, plant and equipment | (288) | (241) |
| Dividends paid | (120) | (110) |
Item 1A. Risk Factors

Borealis Energy operates wind farms in the northern plains. Our results depend on wind conditions; a calm year can reduce generation revenue materially. We also face interest rate risk on variable-rate project debt.
Consolidated Balance Sheets

| (Millions) | December 31, 2022 | December 31, 2021 |
|---|---|---|
| Total current assets | 1,140 | 980 |
| Total current liabilities | 760 | 820 |
| Long-term debt | 3,450 | 3,610 |
| Total stockholders' equity | 2,210 | 2,050 |
Generation statistics

Borealis Energy generated 9.8 terawatt-hours of electricity in 2022, compared with 10.4 terawatt-hours in 2021, as average wind speeds were lower across the fleet. Installed capacity reached 3.1 gigawatts.
Net interest income
Coral Bank's net interest income was $1,320 million in the second quarter of 2023, up from $1,180 million a year earlier, driven by higher yields on commercial loans. Net interest margin was 3.4%.
Capital ratios

| Ratio | June 30, 2023 | December 31, 2022 |
|---|---|---|
| Common equity tier 1 | 11.8% | 11.2% |
| Tier 1 leverage | 8.9% | 8.6% |
Allowance for credit losses
The allowance for credit losses increased to $2,040 million at June 30, 2023 from $1,910 million at December 31, 2022, reflecting growth in commercial real estate exposure.
